typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BATCH_ID as integer (),
	FAC_COUNT as integer (),
	FILE_COUNT as integer (),
	gv_CountOracleTable as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_OutputFolder as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	SQL_DEFAULT_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_PULLED_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	SQL_RUN_DATE_GET_WARP_DATA as string (),
	strDataSource as string (),
	strInitialCatalog as string (),
	strPassword as string (),
	strSqlServerProvider as string (),
	strUserName as string (),
	V_PULLED_DATE as timestamp (),
	V_RUN_DATE as timestamp (),
	V_SERVICE_DATE as string (),
	V_SNPSHT_DATE as string ()
}

source(output(
		POLHLDR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select distinct [POLHLDR_ID]   from [dbo].[STAGE_MEMBER_DETAIL] where batch_id=?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCMEMBERBAL1
OLESRCMEMBERBAL1 aggregate(groupBy(),
	PH_BAL = sum(PH_BAL)) ~> Aggregate
Aggregate derive(PH_BAL = toString(PH_BAL)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(FILE_PREFIX = 'PHD  D7',
		FILE_SUFFIX = ' 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00 000000000.00                    ',
		Data_Conversion_PH_BAL = PH_BAL) ~> DERADDSNPSHTDATE1
DERADDSNPSHTDATE1 sink(input(
		PH_BAL as string,
		SNPSHT_DTE as string,
		FILE_PREFIX as string,
		SERVICE_DATE as string,
		FILE_SUFFIX as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PH_BAL,
		SNPSHT_DTE = V_SNPSHT_DATE,
		FILE_PREFIX,
		SERVICE_DATE = V_SERVICE_DATE,
		FILE_SUFFIX)) ~> FFDMEMBERBAL1
